description: Publish a begin_deploy session's staged files to the live site in one atomic step, after a secret and malware scan of the complete set (on failure the session stays open to retry or abort). Replace mode on a site that has files needs confirm:"I-want-to-replace-all-files". After a timeout or dropped connection, call it again with the same deployId: it returns the running or finished commit instead of starting a second one. Use commit_deploy only to finish a begin_deploy session; deploy_site and update_site publish in one call.

confirm.description: Required only for replace-mode commits against a site that already has files. Pass exactly "I-want-to-replace-all-files" to acknowledge that the live files will be deleted and replaced with the staged set.

delete.description: Patch mode only: site-relative paths to remove from the live site in this commit (e.g. the old path of a renamed file).

dryRun.description: Preview the commit (filesDeployed, deletedFiles, confirm and plan checks) without touching the live site. Skips the secret and malware scan, which the real commit still runs.

name: commit_deploy

allowance.description: Custom domains the team's current plan includes.

connected.description: Custom domains on this site from both sources, one entry per hostname.

source.description: dashboard: linked on the dashboard Web Addresses page. mcp: added with add_custom_domain or the site API.

status.description: live: verified and serving this site. pending: linked, not verified yet.

nextTool.description: Present when this site has no custom domain yet and the team has room for one.

used.description: Distinct custom domains in use across the team, both sources (same count as get_account).

customDomains.description: Custom domains of this site and the team's custom-domain allowance; null when they could not be read. Omitted on dry runs.

customHeaders.description: Result of syncing the _headers file in the site root (site-wide /* response headers).

dryRun.description: True if this was a dry-run; nothing was committed.

manageUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user manages this site (domains, versions, settings). Omitted on dry runs.

title: Commit a staged deploy
